assumptions: tasks are independent and each leaf's score is a mean over its published task count (a binomial leaf drawn from its Jeffreys posterior Beta(k + 1/2, n - k + 1/2), O142; plug-in SDs with the proportion (k + 1/2) / (n + 1), I28); attempts averaged within a task and tasks shared across models are ignored, so the noise is approximate
GDPval-AA: each row's rating interval as AA's model page displays it, read as a 95% normal interval (AA states no level), SD = half-width / 1.96
AA-Omniscience: each of 3,000 questions scores +1, 0 or -1, with the shares from AA's accuracy and hallucination rate
Vals boards (Vibe Code Bench v1.1, Code Migration v1.1): Vals' published standard error per record, read as the leaf's SD
AI Coding Daily: judged points over its six graded projects read as a binomial share of 60 points (an assumption; the board publishes no error)
rankSeparability.bias: net direction not established: treating two rows' errors as independent overstates the threshold, because every row is scored on the same tasks and attempts are averaged within a task; sources it omits (run-to-run and harness variance, AA's single cost run and, on the Plan basis, owner-assumption error) work the other way
rankSeparability.bandRule: O42: rows in value order; a row joins the current band while its value is not separable from the band's first row at correlation 0 (1.96 x sqrt(SD_i^2 + SD_j^2), analytic quality-leaf SDs, cost not drawn), otherwise it starts a new band; every row is inseparable from its band's first row, and adjacent rows in different bands may also be inseparable. O48: on the Plan basis a plan row takes its configuration's SD; a row of the band's first configuration on another plan stays in the band, and adjacent plan rows of one configuration are counted apart from the separability pairs (E258)
